othercustomfield.description: The exact payload string last accepted by the Middleware. Change detection is a direct comparison of this against the freshly built payload - equal means nothing to send. NEVER written on a failure: this must keep meaning "what the destination currently has", or a failed record compares equal on the next save and never syncs again.
